dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software, Japan Medical Association). Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY includes with .INC extension and MCP (middleware communication protocol) pattern typical of JMA ORCA.

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/レセプト) processing — retrieves and edits insurer burden amounts and medical fee data for high-cost medical expense (高額療養費) claims under social/national insurance
purpose.summary: ORCSSKYGET is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that retrieves and assembles insurer-side claim data (公費・高額療養費) for a given treatment month. It handles two processing modes: mode 1 reads receipt-level medical care and food/living expense data from RECE10 and a KOHSKY table; mode 2 queries the tbl_syunou payment collection table to aggregate medical fee totals, patient days, and co-payment amounts by insurer category.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY-based parameter areas (ORCSSKYGETAREA, RECE10-REC, SPA-AREA)
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded, garbled)
PERFORM VARYING loops over indexed insurance/date arrays
COMPUTE arithmetic for medical fee accumulation
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP layer
OCCURS arrays for daily treatment flags (WRK-TAIHI-DAY 31 elements)
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese EUC-JP but the file was decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled multi-byte characters. The program logic is clearly readable. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (~57% of 28148 bytes); the remaining procedure division sections (900-series utility sections) are not shown but referenced. Dialect is GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based on JMA ORCA project conventions.
